:::{#def-truth-table}
#### Truth table

A **truth table**
[@wikipedia_truth_table]
for a [proposition](#def-proposition) built from propositions $P_1, \ldots, P_n$
with [logical connectives](#def-logical-connective)
has one row for each of the $2^n$ combinations of truth values of $P_1, \ldots, P_n$,
and gives the truth value of the proposition in each row.

:::
